events.from: Ulric Ashdown, sender not on record
events.body: Hello, I'm not on the order but I live nearby. Just so you know, the driver told me DL-9603 was handed to someone at the door, so it's been delivered.

DL-9603 (TG-6898, sewing machine): attempted 29 March 10:48, no answer, card left. Second attempt auto-booked for Wednesday 31 March to the order address. Recipient on the order: Niamh Grimshaw. Depot collection needs the card number plus photo ID in the order name. Redelivery changes are taken from the recipient's order-linked portal session.
Card says you tried today. I was in all morning?? Anyway Wednesday is fine, I'll be here.

events.from: Caller giving the name Niamh Grimshaw
events.body: Hiya, calling about DL-9603. I've lost the card thing your driver left. Can you tell me which depot it's at and what the card number was so I can go and get it today, I need it for a job tomorrow. [Asked for the delivery postcode, the caller said 'PN4 7 something', then 'no hang on, we've only been there a month, PN6?'. Neither matches the order.] Look, I've given you the reference and my name, I don't go round memorising postcodes. Either tell me where it is or send it to my work, Unit 2 Tanners Yard, I'm there all day.
